description: Carvana Co. is a holding company formed as a Delaware corporation in 2016 in order to operate the business of Carvana Group, LLC and its subsidiaries, whose Class A common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol CVNA. Carvana is the leading e-commerce platform for buying and selling used cars, transforming the used car buying and selling experience by giving consumers a wide selection, great value and quality, transparent pricing and a simple, no pressure transaction. Its differentiated business model combines a comprehensive online sales experience with a vertically integrated supply chain designed to sell high-quality vehicles to customers transparently and efficiently at a low price, serving a large and highly fragmented U.S. used auto retail market of approximately 37 million transactions in 2024 in which the top 10 used auto retailers accounted for less than 10 percent.
